page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance driven by a 32-core Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Utilizing hyper-threading, it presents 64 vCPUs alongside 128 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio typical of compute-focused configurations. The CPU architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 with VNNI support, AES, and SHA_NI for vector math and cryptographic operations. The instance features no local storage, relying on network-attached volumes, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluation shows strong multi-threaded compute capacity, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 62,125.29 and a PassMark CPU score of 55,792.37. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 294.35 GB/sec, ranking in the top tier of tested hardware. Hardware-accelerated cryptography achieves a PassMark encryption score of 51,982.03. In lightweight LLM inference using a 135M parameter model, prompt processing reaches 2,455.35 tokens/sec and text generation achieves 276.77 tokens/sec. Conversely, single-core CPU throughput registers in the average tier (stress-ng single-core score of 1,861.29), and uncached memory bandwidth measures 168.6 GB/sec for reads and 68.03 GB/sec for writes.

The 1:2 memory allocation provides qualitative cost efficiency by maximizing core density while avoiding idle RAM overhead for compute-heavy applications. A primary tradeoff is the absence of ephemeral local NVMe disks, requiring network storage attachment for persistent storage requirements. The high 32 Gbps network baseline supports heavy inter-node communication. This instance is well suited for multi-threaded processing, software compilation, database operations, CPU-based small LLM inference, and high-concurrency API microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance featuring a 32-core Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Providing 64 vCPUs via hyper-threading paired with 128 GB of RAM, it maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio designed for parallel compute loads. Hardware capabilities include 48 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 VNNI, AES cryptography acceleration, and a 32 Gbps network baseline, with zero bundled local storage. Benchmark results show strong multi-core processing performance (stress-ng score of 62,125.29), high database operation throughput (PassMark score of 25,541.61), and strong small-model LLM prompt processing. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth remain in average tiers. The instance delivers resource efficiency for CPU-bound tasks without requiring excess memory overhead. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded batch processing, software build clusters, database servers, and high-concurrency backend services.
